title: The Emberkeeper — Dragon of the Last Egg
description: A crimson mother dragon shelters a single ivory egg with vast scalloped wings. Her curling tail embraces a ruined basalt hatchery; a glowing volcanic seam keeps the nest warm. Sculpted scales, ivory fangs, swept horns and four planted claws frame the precious egg.
